delivery stage: publish
handoff business: planned · The corrected multi-install promise supersedes singleton semantics and must become current Accounting authority before downstream decisions. · owner: be · inputs: Immutable prior Accounting receipts as history and the explicit v4 multi-instance correction authority · outputs: Validator-accepted corrected Accounting multi-install business authority · verification: Coverage distinguishes module-type entitlement, exact replay, distinct create, installation isolation and excluded legal/tax/billing semantics · depends on: 
handoff architecture: planned · The prior transactional boundary must be re-decided for N Accounting installations and tenant + workspace + installationId isolation. · owner: be · inputs: Corrected v4 business authority and immutable prior architecture evidence · outputs: Validator-accepted multi-install Accounting architecture boundary · verification: Per-install ownership, ledger separation, event non-duplication, currency/correction invariants and shared Studio ownership remain explicit · depends on: business
handoff backend: planned · The backend must replace singleton create/read assumptions with explicit multi-install identities and isolation while preserving the accepted Accounting lifecycle. · owner: be · inputs: Corrected business and architecture authorities, current backend head and prior bounded correction findings · outputs: Backend implementation for exact replay versus distinct create plus per-install authorization, data, ledger and event isolation · verification: Focused unit and PostgreSQL 16 tests prove two instances, replay/new-create distinction, cross-instance denial, non-mixed ledgers and event non-duplication · depends on: architecture
handoff data: planned · API and browser journeys require attributable preconditions for two Accounting installations without fixture-derived create, ledger or isolation outcomes. · owner: be · inputs: Accepted identity and seed plans plus repaired backend contract · outputs: Reversible tenant/workspace/installation-scoped preconditions for two Accounting instances only · verification: Repeat seed is idempotent and no tested instance-create, cross-instance denial or ledger outcome is prewritten · depends on: backend
handoff api: planned · The corrected mission requires owning-API creation and isolation proof across two installations through the served GraphQL boundary. · owner: be · inputs: Served repaired backend and namespaced Accounting preconditions · outputs: Append-only Accounting API E2E run covering two installations, exact replay, distinct create and cross-instance isolation · verification: Replay returns the same installation, distinct create returns another, foreign-instance access fails, ledgers do not mix and one event is not duplicated · depends on: backend, data
handoff interface: planned · The frontend must expose multi-install list/create/select/navigation while keeping each Accounting workbench bound to one installationId. · owner: fe · inputs: Corrected v4 business/architecture authority and current AgentOS module workspace · outputs: Installed AgentOS UI that navigates multiple Accounting installations and preserves each instance's workbench · verification: No new app or inferred company semantics; desktop/mobile create, select and installationId-bound navigation are explicit · depends on: business, architecture
handoff audit: planned · The rendered Accounting surface still needs independent Grammar, accessibility and responsive measurement. · owner: fe · inputs: Served installed Accounting workbench and accepted interface direction · outputs: Validator-accepted frontend surface audit with captures and measurements · verification: Desktop and 390px mobile layouts, accessibility, contrast, hierarchy and overflow are measured on the real route · depends on: interface
handoff uat: planned · A real user must create, replay, create distinctly, select and navigate two Accounting installations and observe isolation on desktop and mobile. · owner: fe · inputs: Served API/UI heads, accepted API proof, surface audit and namespaced preconditions · outputs: Declarative browser-walk records, captures and a validator-accepted Accounting UAT receipt · verification: Exact replay retains one installation, distinct create yields another, navigation switches installationId and visible data/permission states never bleed · depends on: api, audit, data
handoff quality: planned · Both routed repositories require their applicable delivery gates at the exact heads used by API and browser evidence. · owner: be · inputs: Accounting backend repair and accepted frontend implementation · outputs: Independent backend and frontend quality-verification receipts · verification: Repository lint, architecture, typecheck, build and applicable unit/container suites pass without unrelated writes · depends on: backend, interface
handoff reconciliation: planned · The final handoff must reconcile against v4 authority, with singleton-era receipts retained only as historical evidence. · owner: be · inputs: Accepted business authority, API E2E, UAT and both quality receipts · outputs: Validator-accepted business reconciliation and exact backend/frontend outcome heads · verification: Every mission inclusion and exclusion is accounted for and only validator-accepted evidence is claimed · depends on: api, uat, quality
ends: git.publish
